Understanding the need for inclusiveness and innovation in education, Lilavatibai Podar High School, ISC launched their very own school-fest. They chose technology as the underlying theme in 2006 and the legend of Gizmo Geeks began!

Since its inception, our mega tech fest has grown to include participants from over 40 AISM schools across the city. The fest, which is in its 18th edition, was initiated to commemorate the memory of our founder Shri Ganesh Podar and consists of events that blend technology with pedagogy and challenge learners to ideate, create and innovate.
